prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Libre Baskerville and reading text in Inter; traditional serif heading with compact interface text. Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Use body 20px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
